Full summary: Task 10 (inline): timeline-scale.js pure bucketing math TDD'd — chooseBucket (smallest unit ≤120 buckets), bucketize (epoch-aligned sparse buckets, colorKey with entry_type fallback), makeScale (linear transforms). 9 tests green.
Decisions: Chose epoch-multiple bucket alignment with fixed 30d/365d month/year approximations over calendar-exact bucketing — the histogram conveys visual density, axis labels come from real Dates, and pure ms math keeps the module trivially testable; revisit only if users read bucket boundaries as calendar months.
